announcements.insight: FY26 results for an ICG Enterprise Trust typically signal the performance of its private equity portfolio, with current market conditions highlighting pressure on valuation multiples and exit timelines for mid-market assets.

announcements.headline: Reducing management fee cap by 20% over two years to 1.00% of NAV
announcements.insight: This fee reduction aligns ICG Enterprise Trust with the broader industry trend of compressing management fees in the UK AIM-listed investment trust sector to retain investor capital and remain competitive against passive alternatives. While it signals a defensive posture rather than aggressive growth, it mitigates the drag on net asset value returns for shareholders.
